---
title: Set Up Games
description: >-
  Launch interactive gaming, choosing your game type, setting point or voucher
  reward pools, and customizing background themes.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" style="width: 1374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Games > Add Game.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="284" height="171" style="width: 284px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Select game type, set the amount required to play and choose start and end dates for the game’s availability.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="366" height="226" style="width: 366px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Enter the game title in different language.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="379" height="339" style="width: 379px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
